name: Skinner v3.3.2 — Cryptographic Auto-Updater & Security Hardening
changelog: Production-grade automatic update system powered by GitHub Releases with zero manual downloads required.
Cryptographic Ed25519 signature verification with embedded official public verification key.
Mandatory SHA-256 checksum verification against signed release manifests before executable execution.
Safe Windows update handoff helper resolving ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION file locking and preserving all user data.
Strict domain and URL validation restricting asset downloads exclusively to the official dahakabdellah12/Skinner repository.
Zero idle disk thrashing: metadata stat caching eliminates 300MB/3.5s background disk reads.
Sub-millisecond native Win32 Toolhelp32 process detection with zero subprocess spawning.
Robust semantic version comparison supporting numeric precedence and prerelease filtering.
Zip-bomb and OOM protection capping uncompressed archive buffers across SWZ, ANM, and SWF engines.
Sealed WebView navigation handler restricting navigation to internal custom protocols.
